Apple (AAPL) Stake Increased by Haverford Financial Services Inc; Orbcomm (ORBC) Shareholder Hood River Capital Management Has Trimmed Stake as Share Value Declined 
April 24, 2018 - By Linda Rogers 
Haverford Financial Services Inc increased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 2.61% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Haverford Financial Services Inc bought 1,969 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 77,494 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $13.12M, up from 75,525 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Haverford Financial Services Inc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $826.76B market cap company. The stock decreased 1.39% or $2.3 during the last trading session, reaching $162.94. About 31.71M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% since April 24, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500. 
Hood River Capital Management Llc decreased its stake in Orbcomm Inc (ORBC) by 29.43% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Hood River Capital Management Llc sold 391,468 shares as the company’s stock declined 4.41% with the market. The institutional investor held 938,523 shares of the telecommunications equipment company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $9.55 million, down from 1.33 million at the end of the previous reported quarter. Hood River Capital Management Llc who had been investing in Orbcomm Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $704.43 million market cap company. It has underperformed by 5.90% the S&P500.
